title: $\texttt{NAISR}$: A 3D Neural Additive Model for Interpretable Shape Representation

layout.note: Two stacked bands under filled purple pills: a wide Training drawing (left to right: airway shape, stacked input tiles, pink and blue MLP rows with displacement blobs, an aggregation box and plus nodes, a purple template MLP, an SDF image) above a Testing band of four framed sections side by side, each with a trapezoid block and shape renders.

lesson: Split a figure into training and testing with two filled pill labels, and let one colour per covariate follow its branch from input tile through the network, the displacement picture and the test-time block, so the four test-time uses read as re-use of the same trained parts.
